text:
Priya: FYI scheduling a short change window tomorrow 07:30 PT for a base-image rebuild + signer key versioning. Need quick owners for RBAC delta, audit forwarding, and vuln triage.
Ben: I can do RBAC + IAM MR. Question: do we restrict the CI signer to a service account per-cluster or a single global SA?
Diego: Prefer per-cluster SA to limit blast radius. We'll add a wildcard binding for the builder pipeline but scoped per key resource.
Priya: Good. Keep bindings minimal. Also need to ensure cosign annotations include pipeline/job id and image_digest for traceability.
Ben: I'll add mutating step in the build pipeline to emit annotation: cosign --annotations "build_id=${BUILD_ID},sha=${GIT_COMMIT}" sign ...
Claire: On vuln triage: scanner flagged libc6: CVE-2026-XXXX medium and a python package low. Can we patch in a rebuild?
Diego: libc6 patch available in distro repo. Plan: rebuild base with updated libc6 and rerun scanner. If upgrade changes runtime behavior, we'll gate promotion to dedicated pools.
OpsBot: Preflight: base-image:2026-03-21-nightly -> scanner: 2 medium (libc6), 1 low.
Priya: Ok schedule: 06:45 PT build+scan, 07:00 PT sign test image (new key version), 07:30 PT canary push to Dedicated-canary.
Ben: For KMS: we'll create version 3 of key image-signer and grant roles/redwood.kmsSigner to ci-cluster-sa@redwood. Use least-privilege: cloudkms.cryptoKeySign.
Diego: Rollback plan: keep previous key version active for 36h. If signing fails, switch image promotion back to last-signed digest and stop new promotions.
Claire: Audit logs: ensure the KMS admin and signing operations export to security-audit (splunk index). We should add a log-based metric for any cosign failures.
Priya: Add also an Alert runbook: if >5 image-pull failures in 10m during canary, pause rollout and page eng-sre.
Ben: MR: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/pulls/501 - adds roles/redwood.kmsSigner and a condition limiting binding to projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img. PTAL @eng-security.
Diego: Test sign done. cosign command used: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKey/versions/3 gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-21-nightly` signature: sha256:deadbeefcafebabe
OpsBot: Canary push started 07:30 PT -> 50 pods in canary pool pulling new image.
Claire: Monitoring: initial health checks OK, no increased 5xx. Telemetry: image pull latency normal.
Ben: Exported KMS audit logs: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND logName=projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity" --limit 50` shows sign operation by ci-cluster-sa at 07:02 PT. I'll attach the snippet to the MR.
Priya: Reminder: update SBOM and attestations in artifact registry so compliance can pick them up.
Diego: Canary 20m check: 0 auth errors, 0 pull failures. Proceeding staged rollout to 90% then full after 30m.
Claire: Vulnerability scanner re-run after libc6 bump: PASS (1 low). We'll note the mitigation in the compliance ticket.
Priya: Great. After full rollout, revoke unused key versions older than v1 after 72h. Add record in key-rotation runbook.
OpsBot: Event: rollout-complete at 08:40 PT. Audit-forward: security-audit index received 27 events for signing/image-push.
Ben: Closing MR once post-release checks are green. Adding audit note: signer_version=3, signature=sha256:deadbeefcafebabe, build_id=2026-03-21-0892.
Priya: Thanks team. If anyone sees strange cert issues (glibc ABI), call eng-sre immediately. Filing compliance update now. :white_check_mark:
